Put raw images here, then run: python3 build/images.py
All images are made SQUARE except banner (900x500), popup (9:16) and og. Names: see build/images.py.
  banner, popup, logo, og
  categories/<page key>  (slots, live, sports, fishing, jackpot, free-credit, promotions, app)
  providers/<provider key>  (mega888, 918kiss, pussy888, megah5, acewin, vpower, epicwin)
  promos/<promo image>   (promo-1 .. promo-4)
  posts/<post key>
